text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: prod-gateway (gw-prod) - spike in 5xx and timeouts starting ~10:23 UTC, error rate ~4.7% (baseline 0.1%). Routing errors + upstream timeouts. Pager escalated to on-call.

alice_sre: seeing the alert, joining. Any known deploys? :eyes:

bob_eng: Not aware of any planned deploys. Checking CI/CD — nothing merged to gateway in last 2 hours.

carla_oncall: I'm taking first touch. Can folks post quick impact: are customers seeing errors or just internal checks?

dan_prod: Customer reports incoming: multiple API clients hitting 502/504, a few error reports from a big customer in EU region. TTFB high before 5xx.

alice_sre: logs look sparse for some requests. We are missing request-id headers in many of the failing traces - seems like sampling or header loss at edge. Traces often show entry but no downstream spans.

eli_sre: I see a gap in our traces: span ids not being propagated for ~40% of requests since 10:20. Also Datadog traces show a drop in span volume despite traffic increase.

maya_runtime: that's odd — runtime change rolled out yesterday but not in last 2h. However queueing at the gw layer spiked at 10:22. I suspect a proxy config issue or a sudden backend slowdown.

carla_oncall: immediate mitigation ideas? Enable debug logs at gw for 5 minutes to capture headers? We need request IDs to correlate.

bob_eng: +1. If we enable debug logging, we should keep it short due to noise and cost. I'll prepare a quick hotpatch to toggle log level config.

alice_sre: Also, can we add a temporary rule to tag requests missing X-Request-Id and generate one server-side? That would help trace stitching.

eli_sre: We don't have a live toggle for request-id injection in the gateway currently. Could add a sidecar rule, but that's a code change. Quick alternative: edge nginx can add a header if missing. I can push a config snippet.

bob_eng: paste the nginx snippet please, eli.

eli_sre: ```nginx
# add X-Request-Id if missing
map $http_x_request_id $injected_req_id {
  default $http_x_request_id;
  "" $request_id;
}
proxy_set_header X-Request-Id $injected_req_id;
```

carla_oncall: That looks safe. Can we push as a config reload to the edge fleet? That would require rolling configuration. Who can trigger? @deploy-bot ?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Received request to apply config reload to fleet subset. Confirm target namespace and duration window.

bob_eng: I'll coordinate the rollout. Plan: apply to 10% of edge nodes in EU first as a canary, watch for error rate and tracing improvements, then expand.

alice_sre: Meanwhile, enable debug for 5m on the canary nodes to capture missing headers. Also create a temporary sampling override to increase traces to 100% for those nodes.

maya_runtime: on it — increasing sampling and toggling debug via runtime endpoint. Command: 

```bash
curl -X POST http://runtime-admin.local/debug?level=debug
curl -X POST http://runtime-admin.local/tracing?sample=1.0
```

carla_oncall: doing customer comms: posting to status page that we're investigating increased errors and that we've identified an observability gap being addressed.

dan_prod: Customer impacted: EU payments processing delayed. Priority P1 per SLAs. Requesting ETA and whether we need to open bridge with sales.

alice_sre: ETA: 15-30m for canary config reload + metrics. If canary shows tracing restored and 5xx drops, expand.

eli_sre: after enabling header injection on canary, I see X-Request-Id present on previously missing requests in the debug logs. Traces start to stitch.

bob_eng: Rolling to 50% now. Observability: request-span cover increased from 60% -> 92% on canary traffic slice.

alice_sre: Error rate on canary dropped to 0.9% (was 5.1%). Latency  p95 improved ~300ms. This is promising.

carla_oncall: expanding to full fleet. Notifying support and customer success of timeline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started rollout to remaining edge nodes. Estimated completion 10m.

bob_eng: Rollout done. Metrics trending back to normal. We should keep debug sampling for another 10m to validate and then revert to baseline.

eli_sre: Postmortem action: add a runtime flag to enable request-id injection at the gateway without config reloads. Also add a fallback in our SDKs to insist on header presence.

alice_sre: Observability action items: ensure trace sampling override is available from Console for P1 incidents, add alert when span volume drops >30% relative to traffic, and audit places that strip headers.

maya_runtime: I also want to investigate why header propagation dropped: possible upstream proxy update in front of us in EU had a default config that removed unknown headers. I'll open a ticket linking the proxy team.

carla_oncall: drafting incident summary for follow-up: root cause suspected: intermittent header-stripping at edge causing missing request IDs which prevented backend correlation and increased retries/timeouts; stopgap: nginx header injection and sampling override; customer impact: delays/errors for EU customers, now mitigated.

dan_prod: Customer notified and acknowledged. They appreciate the quick mitigation. Keep me posted if there are any regressions.

alice_sre: keeping thread open for 1h to collect logs. Will update with preliminary RCA within 24h. Great job everyone :thumbsup: :shipit:
